blocks.text: Sydney Sweeney’s latest advertising campaign has drawn criticism from female athletes, who argue that its portrayal of women contributes to their sexualization in sports. The campaign promotes Novig, a U.S.-based sports prediction and trading platform, rather than an actual sport or athletic competition. It features Sweeney wearing little to no clothing as she poses as if participating in various sports. For women who spent years in training, competing and pushing their bodies to their limits, being reduced to their appearance can feel like a familiar story.
